name: Launch Control XL3 · Surface
description: DAW Control mode with screen names/values and LEDs (docs/LCXL3_LAYOUT.md). Knobs: macros, LFOs, sound core; faders: filter + amp envelopes; buttons: tone select, stop track / stop all, setlist, clips of the selected track. Page = part/track bank, Track = part/track. DAW Mixer button: levels, pans, routing of the selected tone/part, master FX, solo/mute. Novation button (tap: latch, hold: while held): page shortcuts, context knobs, pitch envelope, scene select/launch/stop. Solo/Mute: the selected tone (PATCH) or part (PERFORM). Shift: launch/stop now, tap tempo (Play), tempo -/+1 (Track), tone mute (tone buttons), setlist first/last, clear solos/mutes.
